description: Überschwemmungsgebiete Landkreis Lüchow-Dannenberg is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by luechow-dannenberg.de. Restriction of legally binding floodplains. The associated restrictions on the use of land are regulated in the Water Management Act (§ 78 WHG). The data is created as a polygon. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Floodplains district Lüchow-Dannenberg" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opendata, GDIMRH, inspireidentifiziert. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2022-12-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
